integrationNotes: The archived letta-main.zip remains a historical/governance reference; it is not imported as the current runtime.
The runtime adapter uses the current Letta TypeScript Agent SDK with MemFS enabled.
Provider responses must not directly mutate NK1 canonical memory, goals, self-model, or action state.
SDK dependency and lockfile still require a reproducible Node 24 install before release.
Cloud backend is never inferred from the mere presence of LETTA_API_KEY; NK1_LETTA_BACKEND=cloud is required.
The adapter uses an allowlisted set of file tools, disables server-side web tools/skills, and enables the SDK memory-filesystem confinement for local sessions.
Hybrid recall returns native NK1 records plus a separate untrusted Letta candidate; callers must review it and it is not automatically stored as canonical memory.
